body:
Quick pass (read only, no build).

- The PR merges cleanly with `main` (`mergeStateStatus` CLEAN).
- The author's gate is green on the head `02ceecef5`: 804 steps, 0 failed. It ran the batch steps of the crates that depend on `cl`, and clippy.
- The pinning tests are `crates/app/tests/wcs_start.rs` and `crates/cl/tests/origin_approach.rs`.
- The body is complete. No golden file changed.

The PR is ready for the independent review. The work is under the safety floor.

Read-only safety-floor review (Opus, diff only, not built) of head 02ceecef5f79953be3d584ccbb27a44944d9010f.

Verdict: clean

What I read:
- The diff, and `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` at this head around the new call (the job unpack, the yaw entry, the `hl` heights, the yaw exit and the laws after it).
- `crates/app/src/operation/wcs_yaw.rs` and `job.rs`: `WcsYaw.origin` and `wcs_origin` both come from `posting::wcs_context`. The yaw exit turns the path about the WCS origin, so the seated start stays on the WCS origin after the exit.
- The `onRapid` function of each `assets/posts/*.cps` file at this head. No `onRapid` reads `StartX` or `StartY`. The first rapid writes its end only. `seat_approach` changes only the start of a first move that is a rapid, so no posted block changes. The `StartX/Y/Z` value that the engine gives to a script changes for that first rapid only.
- The seed sites (`PathBuilder::approached`) in `crates/motion`. The milling families seed at `(0, 0, clearance_z)`, and the arms give `hl.clearance` as `clearance_z`.

Safety points:
- The rapid end does not change. The Z of the start does not change. Only the X/Y of the start moves.
- The call is before the yaw exit, the fixture routing and the verify laws. Thus the laws judge the new opening rapid. No refusal or check is removed or weakened.
- A non-finite origin is refused (`seat_approach` returns false and changes nothing). An empty path, an arc, a non-rapid first move, a start that is not the seed, and a zero-length X/Y rapid are not changed.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic` outside tests. No index math.

Notes (not blockers):
- note: `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` line 2909. If an arm gives its generator a clearance that is not `hl.clearance`, the seed Z does not agree. Then `seat_approach` does nothing, and that operation still opens at the world origin with no diagnostic. The posted G-code stays correct in that case. The tests pin only Face and 3D Parallel. About 30 seed sites exist (2D, 3D finishing). Recommendation: a follow-up test that generates each seeded family with a moved WCS and asserts the opening start.
- note: a 3+2 path (`TiltedFrame::to_local`) and a yaw-rotated WCS have no pinning test with a moved WCS origin. The PR body says this. I read the yaw path and it is correct by construction. I did not prove the 3+2 case.
- note: when the first rapid also descends in Z, the moved start makes it a longer diagonal rapid. The verify laws judge that rapid, so a fixture in its way gives a refusal, not a silent pass. Such a refusal is conservative: the posted program does not command that start point.
- note: `generate.rs` has about 3829 lines. This is far past the 400-line rule. The PR adds 9 lines. The size existed before this PR.

What I did not check:
- I did not build and did not run tests.
- I did not read the simulation link code or the CL `START` writer at this head.
- I did not read the 5-axis kinematics solver for the first move. The tool axis of the moved start does not change, so I expect no rotary change. I did not prove it.
- I did not check each of the about 30 arms for the value that it gives as `clearance_z`.
